name: steghide - Hide/Extract Data in Images and Audio
description: steghide embeds and extracts hidden data in JPEG, BMP, WAV, and AU files, optionally passphrase-protected. Common in CTF and occasionally in real loot (exfil via images). Extraction requires the passphrase, which is often blank, a known word, or crackable with stegseek.
notes:
=== EXTRACT (try blank passphrase first) ===
  steghide extract -sf image.jpg
  # When prompted for passphrase, press Enter (blank) first

=== EXTRACT WITH KNOWN PASSPHRASE ===
  steghide extract -sf image.jpg -p "<password>"

=== CHECK IF DATA IS PRESENT / INFO ===
  steghide info image.jpg

=== EMBED DATA ===
  steghide embed -cf cover.jpg -ef secret.txt -p "<password>"

=== CRACK THE PASSPHRASE (fast) ===
  stegseek image.jpg /usr/share/wordlists/rockyou.txt
  # stegseek is ~1000x faster than stegcracker

=== SUPPORTED CARRIERS ===
  JPEG, BMP, WAV, AU  (NOT PNG/GIF - use zsteg/other for those)

=== TRIAGE WORKFLOW FOR AN IMAGE ===
  file image.jpg               # confirm type
  exiftool image.jpg           # metadata/comments
  strings image.jpg | less     # embedded text
  binwalk image.jpg            # appended archives
  steghide info image.jpg      # steghide payload
  stegseek image.jpg rockyou.txt  # crack passphrase
  zsteg image.png              # for PNG/BMP LSB

recommended.note: Crack the steghide passphrase at high speed.
Hidden archives also show up in challenges.

defense.why_it_works: Steganography hides data inside carrier files that look benign. Detection is hard without the original cover file or statistical steganalysis; it is primarily an offline/CTF technique.
defense.prerequisites: Possession of the carrier file; passphrase (or crack it).
defense.impact: Concealed data extraction / covert exfiltration channel.
defense.detection: [MITRE T1027.003] Hard to detect in transit. Statistical steganalysis (chi-square, stegdetect) on images; anomalous file size vs. content; outbound images to unusual destinations.
defense.artifacts: Carrier files with abnormal entropy/size; steghide present on a host; unusual image exfil.
defense.splunk_spl: N/A - primarily offline; monitor large/anomalous image egress at the proxy
defense.elastic_kql: file.extension:(jpg OR jpeg OR wav) and file.size > 5000000
defense.sentinel_kql:
DeviceFileEvents
| where FileName endswith ".jpg" or FileName endswith ".wav"
| where FileSize > 5000000
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, FileName, FileSize
defense.prevention: DLP with steganalysis; block/monitor steganography tools on endpoints; inspect anomalous media egress; strip metadata and re-encode media at trust boundaries.
